fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects potentially suspicious execution of the Qemu utility in a Windows environment.
Threat actors have leveraged this utility and this technique for achieving network access as reported by Kaspersky.
fields.name: Potentially Suspicious Usage Of Qemu
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.cmdline contains "-m 1M" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-m 2M" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "-m 3M") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "restrict=off" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-netdev " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "connect=" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "-nographic")) and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -cdrom " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " type=virt " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -blockdev "))))
